title: Fynca 2500$ Trading Challenge
author: Fynca
selftext:
A huge thank you to everyone who joined our first challenge and shared their feedback. We listened, and this time, we’re making the tournament longer.

We got way more interest than we expected, so we decided to run another one, this time with **$2,500 in real cash prizes**.

The format stays simple:

Everyone trades with demo capital.  
No real money is at risk.  
You have 11 days to generate the highest return possible.

The next challenge runs **Aug 31 – Sep 10**.

If you missed the first one and want to compete in the next, registration is now open.
